messages.text: I want a taf that answers refund requests, and refunds anything up to €150 on its own.
Got it. Refunds will read new requests in Gmail and refund through Stripe. Up to €150 each, it refunds on its own; above that, it asks you first. Where do the requests come in?
To support@ in Gmail. And never more than €1,000 a day in total.
Done: €150 per refund, and €1,000 a day in total. Next I'll connect Gmail and Stripe, then you approve the Card.
